name: Paired mandibles
description: Two Soldier mandibles bound at the elbow so they come back to you. The concave chevron silhouette is kept from the original boomerang — it reads at any rotation, which matters for a thing that spins the whole time it is airborne. No spin animation is declared here on purpose: whole-body rotation is the engine's job (the weapon code already does `sprite.rotation += spin * dt`), and a document animation can only move parts within the body.
